import unittest
from fractions import Fraction

from solution import summarize_tokens


class SummarizeTokensTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_returns_count_and_exact_fraction(self):
        result = summarize_tokens(["1", "2", "4", "STOP"])
        self.assertEqual(result, (3, Fraction(7, 3)))
        self.assertIsInstance(result[1], Fraction)

    def test_allows_surrounding_numeric_whitespace(self):
        self.assertEqual(summarize_tokens(("  10", "20\t", " STOP")), (2, Fraction(15, 1)))

    def test_single_number(self):
        self.assertEqual(summarize_tokens(["7", "STOP"]), (1, Fraction(7, 1)))

    def test_does_not_mutate_input(self):
        tokens = ["2", "8", "STOP"]
        before = tokens.copy()
        summarize_tokens(tokens)
        self.assertEqual(tokens, before)

    def test_rejects_bad_container_or_non_string_tokens(self):
        for tokens in ("1 STOP", 123, None, ["1", 2, "STOP"], [True, "STOP"]):
            with self.subTest(tokens=tokens):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    summarize_tokens(tokens)

    def test_rejects_missing_or_misplaced_sentinel(self):
        invalid = [[], ["1"], ["STOP"], ["STOP", "1"], ["1", "STOP", "2"], ["1", "STOP", "STOP"]]
        for tokens in invalid:
            with self.subTest(tokens=tokens):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    summarize_tokens(tokens)

    def test_rejects_non_positive_or_non_integer_numeric_tokens(self):
        invalid = [
            ["0", "STOP"],
            ["-1", "STOP"],
            ["1.5", "STOP"],
            ["one", "STOP"],
            ["", "STOP"],
            ["   ", "STOP"],
            ["1e2", "STOP"],
        ]
        for tokens in invalid:
            with self.subTest(tokens=tokens):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    summarize_tokens(tokens)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
